name: Paratrooper Supply Bundle
blurb: A Hangar-only cargo bundle with deployed and packed canopy review nodes for Leyte airborne-delivery scenes.
history: Airborne forces dropped supplies in bundles suspended beneath cargo parachutes. This model preserves that operational silhouette while labeling the bundle dimensions and canopy geometry as estimates because no type-specific primary drawing was locked in F3.

sources.title: Department of Defense Handbook for Air Delivery Systems
